newsitem.title: THAILAND: Thai oil crushers buy 50,000 tonnes U.S. soybeans.
newsitem.headline: Thai oil crushers buy 50,000 tonnes U.S. soybeans.

text.p: Thai oil crushers have bought 50,000 tonnes of U.S. soybeans for January shipment, Settasan Settakarun of the Thai Cottonseed, Ricebran and Vegetable Oil Crushers Association said on Tuesday.
Market sources said the tender was settled at around $291-$295 a tonne C&F Bangkok and trader Louis Dreyfus was the supplier. But Settasan declined to comment on details.
The previous tender was done in late October when the association bought 50,000 tonnes of US-origin soybean for prompt shipment.
